# NP-06 · Functional Screen Framework

## Struktur standar setiap layar (Standard structure of every screen)

1. Header
2. Area Status (Status Area)
3. Konten Utama (Main Content)
4. Aksi Utama (Primary Action)
5. Aksi Sekunder (Secondary Action)
6. Panel Informasi (Information Panel)
7. Navigasi (Navigation)
8. State & Feedback
9. Izin (Permission)
10. Responsif (Responsive)
11. Audit & Log
12. Konsistensi (Consistency)
13. Bahasa (Language)
14. Aturan Bisnis (Business Rule)

## States

| State | Teks default (Default copy) |
| --- | --- |
| Default | Tampilan normal dengan data. (Normal view with data.) |
| Memuat (Loading) | Memuat data… Mohon tunggu sebentar. (Loading… One moment please.) |
| Kosong (Empty) | Belum ada cucian yang menunggu. (Nothing is waiting.) |
| Berhasil (Success) | Cucian berhasil diterima. (Laundry received.) |
| Peringatan (Warning) | SLA hampir habis. (SLA almost up.) |
| Error | Berat belum diisi. (Weight is missing.) |
| Tanpa Akses (No Permission) | Anda tidak memiliki akses untuk tindakan ini. (You do not have access to this action.) |
| Offline | Koneksi terputus. Data akan dikirim saat online kembali. (Connection lost. Data will be sent when you are back online.) |

## Audit model

Append-only log. Every entry records: User, Waktu (Timestamp), Event, Record, Nilai lama (Previous value), Nilai baru (New value).

| Event | Arti (Meaning) |
| --- | --- |
| `AUTH.LOGIN` | Login |
| `ORD.STATUS` | Perubahan status (Status change) |
| `ORD.PICKUP` | Pickup selesai (Pickup completed) |
| `ORD.RECEIVE` | Cucian diterima (Laundry received) |
| `PRC.START` | Proses dimulai (Process started) |
| `PRC.COMPLETE` | Proses selesai (Process completed) |
| `QC.RESULT` | Hasil QC (QC result) |
| `ISS.CREATE` | Masalah dibuat (Issue created) |
| `APR.DECISION` | Keputusan persetujuan (Approval decision) |
| `PRICE.CHANGE` | Perubahan harga (Price change) |
| `BILL.CHANGE` | Perubahan billing (Billing change) |
| `PAY.RECORD` | Pembayaran dicatat (Payment recorded) |
| `ORD.CANCEL` | Pembatalan (Cancellation) |
| `DOC.VOID` | Void dokumen (Document void) |
| `STK.ADJUST` | Penyesuaian stok (Stock adjustment) |
| `DLV.POD` | Bukti pengiriman (Proof of delivery) |
| `MD.CHANGE` | Perubahan master data (Master data change) |
| `SYS.CHANGE` | Perubahan pengaturan / akses (Settings / access change) |

| Radius | 22/16/12 | 22/16/12 | 18/16/12 |
| Icon | 20 / 24 / 28 px | 20 / 24 / 28 px | 20 / 24 / 28 px |
| Button | 56 primary / 48 secondary | 56 / 48 | 56 / 48, full width |
| Touch target | ≥ 44 px (48) | ≥ 44 px (48) | ≥ 44 px (48) |
| Chip | 13.5 px pill | 13.5 px | 13.5 px |
| Table | 9×12 px cells, 14.5 px | compact 4–5 columns | cards |

## Validation copy

Say what is wrong and how to fix it, in everyday words, under the field. Write “Berat wajib diisi.”, never “weight_required_error”. No error codes, no ERP terms on frontline screens.
